title: Responsive card grid
summary: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(140px, 1fr)): as many equal columns as fit.
explanation: minmax(140px, 1fr) says a column is at least 140px and otherwise shares space equally. auto-fill creates as many such columns as the row can hold.
Unlike wrapping flex items, every column is the same width, including on the last row.
grid-auto-rows sets the height of the rows the grid creates for you.
tryThis: Change auto-fill to auto-fit and delete cards until there are three: auto-fit stretches them.
Make one card span two columns with grid-column: span 2.
